resources.string: Needs notification access. Hidden notifications can\'t be brought back, and calls, media, navigation and alarms are never touched. Apps stay readable while their unlock duration is running.
Keeps what locked apps send out of the notification shade and off the lock screen
Notification access is off. Tap to grant it again.
App Lock Revived\'s own notifications are turned off, so hidden notifications are removed without a placeholder
Content leaves a \"Notification hidden\" placeholder that opens the app. Completely drops the notification.
To hide notifications of locked apps, App Lock Revived has to see them when they arrive. In the next screen, turn on \"%1$s\".
Notifications are only checked on this device. Their text is never stored, logged or sent anywhere.
If the switch is greyed out or Android says \"Restricted setting\": open App info for %1$s, tap the three dots (top right), choose \"Allow restricted settings\" and try again.
Shown in place of notifications from locked apps
Tap to open the app and unlock it
